你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

 "reply": "Hi Mark,\n\nThank you for your inquiry and your interest in our 1.7L stainless steel kettle. It is one of our best sellers for the US market and a strong fit for Amazon sellers. Here is our initial proposal.\n\n1. Product & Compliance\n- Model: [Model No.], 1.7L, food-grade 304 stainless steel inner body, 120V/60Hz, [1500W], auto shut-off and boil-dry protection.\n- UL: [This model is UL listed under file no. XXXXX. We can send the certificate and listing link for your verification.] / [This model is currently ETL listed. A new UL listing usually takes several weeks, so it would not fit a 20-day schedule. Please let me know if ETL is acceptable for your Amazon listing.]\n- BPA free: All plastic parts in contact with water are BPA free. We can provide [FDA / LFGB] food-contact test reports from [SGS/Intertek].\n- Custom branding: Your logo printed on a custom color box, plus logo on the kettle body (silk-screen or laser) at no extra charge for 1,200 pcs. We can also apply FNSKU labels and pack to Amazon FBA requirements, including carton labels, carton weight under 50 lb and suffocation warnings if needed.\n\n2. Price for 1,200 pcs\n- FOB Ningbo (sea): USD [X.XX]/pc\n- FCA Ningbo Airport (air): USD [X.XX]/pc\n- Air freight to Houston/Dallas, for reference: about USD [X.XX]/kg. The total shipment is about [XXX] kg / [X.X] CBM. We can also quote DDP by air to your warehouse or directly to an Amazon FBA center, which saves you from handling customs clearance.\n\nA note on terms: FOB applies to sea shipments. For air freight, FCA (Ningbo airport) is the matching term. Either way, we will make the export process easy for you.\n\n3. Lead Time\n- Custom printed boxes: about [7] days after artwork approval.\n- Mass production: [X] days. We have [some stock of the base model / reserved line capacity], so we will make every effort to meet your schedule.\n- Air freight: about 3–5 days to Texas.\n- Realistic total: about [XX] days from deposit and artwork confirmation to delivery in Texas. To get as close to 20 days as possible, we suggest sending your logo file (AI/PDF) right away so we can start the box artwork today.\n\n4. Payment\nWe understand and respect your usual 60-day terms. For a first order, our standard is 30% deposit and 70% balance against B/L or AWB copy before release. We are also happy to process the order through Alibaba Trade Assurance, which fully protects your payment for quality and on-time delivery. Once we build a steady relationship, we would be glad to discuss open account terms for repeat orders.\n\n5. Next Steps\n- We can send a pre-production sample with your logo by express in about [X] days. The sample fee will be refunded when the order is placed.\n- Please confirm your preferred delivery address (warehouse or FBA center) so I can finalize the freight quote.\n- Do you also need a plug, voltage or color variation? We offer [matte black / brushed steel / white] options for Amazon variation listings.\n\nWe have supplied many Amazon sellers in the US and know how much reviews depend on consistent quality. Every unit gets a 100% water-leak and power test before packing, and we can arrange third-party inspection at your request.\n\nLooking forward to working with you. Feel free to reach me on WhatsApp/WeChat at [number] for a faster response.\n\nBest regards,\n[Your Name]\n[Sales Manager], [Company Name]\nTel/WhatsApp: [number] | Email: [email]"
}
